Passed on the fake backend only by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/hanruihua__rl_rvo_nav --backend fake (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; reviewed_by is null, no hardware backend is declared and no hardware run exists. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's family-config GymnasiumDriver cannot express this upstream, which defines step_ir(action, vel_type='omni', stop=True) with four per-robot lists and reset(mode=0) with no seed, but no step and no seed control; the Gymnasium bridge calls env.step and env.reset(seed=...), so this package is a direct Driver over the card's native gym_env.envs:mrnav with a package fake. The upstream package (gym 0.20.0, torch, numpy and the external ir-sim v2.5) was never installed, imported or run; fake.py is a two-robot kinematic stand-in with no obstacles, was not compared with ir-sim, and its start positions, rewards and time constant are test data. cap.world.step.v1 carries the upstream's per-robot observation, reward, done and info lists in observation, sums the rewards into the class's scalar reward, stops at no truncation and hashes the observation, tick and episode; cap.world.reset.v1 forwards options.mode to mrnav.reset and reports seed 0 because the class output requires a seed and the clone has none (fidelity determinism kind none). No Limits are declared: the declared [-1,1] action space is the policy's normalised output, converted by the training loop to an absolute velocity before step_ir, so it does not bound this binding's commands, and this simulated R0 driver has no operator-required bound. Snapshot/restore and render are not bound; the reset is partial because env_reset resets the robots only. G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE is the expected warning because no actuating limit is declared; every other CL3 test passed. Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the digest the last check printed.
